basics.name: Jacques Thomazo
basics.label: Backend Software Engineer — EV Battery Telematics Platforms
basics.summary: Python backend engineer building telemetry, diagnostics and data platforms for connected EV fleets. Backed by 15 years of battery engineering, from cell chemistry to battery systems design.

work.name: Forsee Power
work.position: Senior Battery Data Scientist (Backend & Platform Engineering)
work.summary: Creator and maintainer of the fleet data platform: 8 repositories and 13 Python packages, from telematics gateways to the reporting API.
highlights: Automate remote diagnostic reporting for telemetry-equipped vehicles, cutting per-report turnaround from 1 day to 200 seconds and cost from €1,000 to €0.50.
Build the IoT backend in Python and FastAPI (REST and WebSocket APIs, Pydantic models, MongoDB), deployed on-prem with Docker on Linux.
Configure telematics gateways to monitor CAN/UDS/J1939 traffic for 100 vehicles across 8 customers, 7 products and 2 generations.
Architect a versioned multi-repository platform as primary developer in a two-person team, with every repository gated in GitHub Actions by a shared standard (uv, ruff, ty, pytest, pre-commit).
Lead a cross-functional team of 5 managers and 19 departmental ambassadors to implement a company-wide SharePoint service containing 100+ resources.

work.name: Forsee Power
highlights: Reworked the embedded SOH estimation algorithms, bringing accuracy to ±3 %.
Led development of a next-generation, high-cell-integration-density battery platform (cell-to-pack mass ratio >80 %) as functional lead of a 5-person team across 2 sites.
Built Python tooling to extract, filter and analyse gigabytes of UDS/CAN logs from pack-level SOH test campaigns.
Quantified fluxgate vs shunt current-sensor drift and its impact on SOC/SOH estimation accuracy.
Built a hybrid fuel-cell battery system model to explore energy management strategies (MATLAB/Simulink/Simscape).
Delivered five in-house manufactured prototype packs (17 kWh, 800 V, LTO) for a key railway project.
work.summary: Battery system development, from embedded algorithms to prototype packs.

work.name: McLaren Applied
work.summary: Technical lead on a top-tier, high-performance racing EV battery concept.
highlights: Simulated and optimised battery system sizing in MATLAB/Simulink against tender requirements: 43 kWh, 600 kW, 284 kg, 220 L, 800 V.
Defined, tracked and analysed results of a cell performance test plan.

work.name: ARRIVAL
work.summary: ISO 26262 functional safety across HV battery, steer-by-wire and brake-by-wire products.
highlights: Led functional safety analysis (HARA, FMEA) for the HV battery (ASIL C) and the steer-by-wire and brake-by-wire products (both ASIL D).
Led functional safety implementation across all three products.

work.name: ARRIVAL
work.summary: Development lifecycle owner for HV & LV batteries, PCBs and electrical systems.
highlights: Owned requirements, concepts and design reviews for a modular 2 kWh, 400 V architecture.
Owned testing and validation across the same systems.

work.name: Vantage Power
work.summary: Cell-level test bench for performance and durability testing.
highlights: Implemented a long-term (6 months) cell-level test bench (0–5 V and 25 A/channel × 16 channels), from specifications onwards.
Built the continuous data monitoring pipelines for a 6-month, 16-channel cell-level test bench.

work.name: Vantage Power
work.summary: Multidisciplinary battery engineer across HV components, production, prototyping and simulation.
highlights: Sized and selected HV components for a 600 V architecture.
Produced a small batch of 4 × 15 kWh battery systems and 3D-prototyped a 10-part batch of PETG PDU enclosures.
Simulated immersion cooling for a dual 15 kWh pack system.

work.name: Renault
work.summary: Battery safety validation for hybrid and electric vehicle battery systems, from 48 to 400 V.
highlights: Built, led and owned mechanical, thermal and electrical battery safety validation.
Validated the battery systems of Twizy, Fluence, Kangoo, ZOE Gen 1 & 2 and a 48 V LTO mild-hybrid battery.

work.name: EDF R&D — IRDEP
work.summary: Synthesis and characterisation of the zinc oxide front layer of CIGS thin-film photovoltaic cells.
highlights: Synthesised the layer electrochemically in aqueous solution.
Characterised the resulting layers (Hall effect, electrochemical impedance, four-point resistivity, Schottky diode impedance).
Characterised the completed cells.

work.name: LANXESS — Ion Exchange Resins
work.summary: Design, sizing and development of a laboratory production rig for monodisperse beads.
highlights: Studied microfluidic production approaches.
Sized the system and ran lab tests with microfluidic chips.
Implemented the continuous-flow process steps downstream of the chip.

work.name: Chimie ParisTech — LCMCP
work.summary: Research on non-linear optical materials (YAB) at the Laboratoire de Chimie de la Matière Condensée de Paris.
highlights: Synthesised solid-state materials.
Characterised the materials (microscopy, XRD, DSC, TGA).
Ran laser tests.

work.name: Hitex
work.summary: Optimisation of an industrial-scale extraction process.
highlights: Worked autonomously on a batch process across double-shift operation (extraction, decantation, filtration, evaporative concentration, drying).
Proposed process improvements.

education.institution: École Nationale Supérieure de Chimie de Paris (Chimie ParisTech)
education.area: Renewable Energy, Chemistry, Electrochemistry, Physical Chemistry and Semiconductors
